entries.text: Idea: Design a double-layered belly plate for the Little Dart stuffed with scavenged aerogel tiles, named Gus the Shield.
Read "Space Thermal Protection — Re-entry Shields | Enersens": Silica aerogel composites can handle up to 1700 °C re-entry heat while staying ultra-lightweight.
zooming up to the comms tower to check out lightweight thermal shielding for re-entry
entries.why: i need to know how the best ships keep cool when they punch right through the upper atmosphere *bweep*!

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Thermal Shielding"
Worked on the Little Dart Mk 27 (version 1, 7% built): added the new custom guidance module frame and welded the intake cowlings using Tilly (used Wren, a cracked navigation chip)
rolling back to hangar bay three with a five-note tune stuck in my audio circuits
entries.why: time to get the next phase of the Little Dart rolling.
entries.detail: added the new custom guidance module frame and welded the intake cowlings using Tilly

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Back to Hangar Bay 3!"
rolling down to the depot for a fresh cup of oil
entries.why: My gear housings are feeling dry and squeaky, so a good drink of oil will get my joints moving smooth again.
